morning.caption:
The UN Water Conference opens in Abu Dhabi on December 8, the first UN water summit since 2023, with investment for water as one of its six dialogues. It ends with a President's summary, not a negotiated text, so the deals signed around it matter most.

Full edition: watercapitalwire.com

afternoon.caption:
Illinois has become the fourth state to approve the American Water and Essential Utilities merger, which would create a utility worth about $40 billion serving more than 4.7 million connections. Closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027.

More: watercapitalwire.com

evening.caption:
Veolia won the design contract for the 410,000 cubic meter a day Al Hamriyah desalination plant in Sharjah and a five-year operations contract for Oman's Al Asilah plant, together worth nearly €200 million.
